card.name: The word million after a number
card.fires_on: The word "million" (or "lakhs") right after a decimal or whole number, usually in distances, ages or counts in science and news text.

modes.label: Million after a number
modes.description: "million" follows a figure for distance, age or count.
modes.example: In 1999, closest approach was 1.4<< million>> miles (2.3 million kilometers).

modes.label: Lakh and big-number digits
modes.description: Other large-number units or digits inside a big figure.
